title: 宽松政策托底弱广度，创新药与光模块事件提供结构线索；油气呈潜在反转 + 美股盘前：油价反弹与长债上行压低期指，KOD与NVDA逆势走强
summary: 央行继续强调适度宽松和逆周期调节，上交所创新药与软件服务指数将发布；9月25日AKShare宽度仍偏弱。周五美股电气设备、建筑产品、3D打印和OLED居前，周一油价从油气板块弱势中反弹。华东医药、汇绿生态列条件关注，金银河因较大定增摊薄列回避。｜美东约8:24，道指、标普500和纳指100期货分别约跌0.50%、0.36%和0.60%；WTI约涨3.05%至95.23美元，Brent约涨2.46%至99.84美元，10年期美债收益率约5.21%。KOD因DAYBREAK三期试验结果盘前大涨，NVDA受回购授权消息支撑；META、TSLA与贵金属矿商承压。

关键词云图

本地宽度偏弱 期指回吐 油气潜在反转 逆周期加力 科创指数扩容 先进制造映射 GLP-1里程碑 光模块扩产 定增摊薄
利好利空中性w1-w5表示重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
美股
周五三大指数收涨，苹果再创收盘新高
9月25日道指、标普500和纳指分别上涨0.93%、0.51%和0.48%，但周一早段三大期指均约跌0.3%，现金盘强势没有延续为全面风险偏好。
能源
原油由周五下跌转为周一反弹
周五WTI和Brent结算价分别跌2.33%和2.14%；08:32附近延迟报价显示两者反弹至约93.57和98.63美元、涨约1.26%和1.22%，油气链是潜在反转，仍须开盘确认。
地缘
霍尔木兹谈判与也门风险并存
伊美就开放霍尔木兹海峡的七天方案继续沟通，法国同时表示将保护沙特延布港油设施；缓和与供应安全风险并存，油价波动仍可能外溢至航运、化工和成长估值。
政策
央行三季度例会强调加大逆周期调节
会议延续适度宽松基调，要求综合运用并适时调整工具、保持流动性充裕；这为指数提供托底，但9月25日AKShare宽度仍为1120涨、4305跌。
政策
金融产品网络营销新规9月30日起实施
八部门办法要求厘清金融机构与第三方平台权责，禁止虚假或误导性营销；平台、券商、银行及金融科技服务商面临合规改造。
政策
创新药与科创软件服务指数9月29日发布
上交所与中证指数将发布上证创新药科创领先指数和上证科创板软件服务指数，提供新的跟踪工具；指数发布不等同于成分股立即上涨。
产业
机器人产业仍受毫米级精度约束
宇树科技王兴兴称AI模型与物理世界匹配的毫米级误差仍是核心瓶颈；长安汽车称力争2028年量产人形机器人，路线明确但商业化时点较远。
美股映射
电气设备、建筑产品与3D打印居前
9月25日美股行业榜中电气设备及零件+3.48%、建筑产品与设备+3.02%，概念榜3D打印+3.38%、OLED+2.30%；A/H先进制造只在本地成交和相对强度同步改善时映射。
公司
华东医药口服GLP-1三期取得积极顶线结果
HDM1002体重管理中国三期研究达到全部主要终点和关键次要终点，公司已完成Pre-NDA沟通；审批、商业化竞争和开盘反馈仍是反证。
科技
汇绿生态拟3.09亿元扩建高速光模块产线
项目计划新增年产200万支高速率光模块产线；最近可得交易日9月24日股价仍跌2.80%，扩产叙事尚未获得价格确认。
公司
金银河拟定增不超15亿元，股份上限达发行前股本30%
资金拟投向钠电、固态电池装备和硅基材料等项目；产业升级与最长约30%的股份摊薄并存，不能把募投用途直接包装成多头。

美股夜盘行情总结

指数与宏观
周五风险资产收高，周一期指和贵金属回落
标普500周五涨0.51%，08:32延迟行情显示标普、纳指100和道指期货约跌0.29%、0.32%和0.33%，黄金跌0.63%；风险偏好较现金盘降温。
板块与映射
先进制造居前，油气由落后转为潜在反转
电气设备、房地产开发和建筑产品位列行业Top3；油气勘探和钻探周五居Bottom5，但周一WTI与Brent反弹逾1%，A/H能源仅列潜在反转，先进制造亦须本地宽度确认。
代表股核验
15只代表股已批量复核，未取得周一同步盘前报价
周五延长时段样本中ELPW、SRFM、EEIQ、SLMT等仍强，但与周一期指不同步；不将周五个股报价冒充当前确认，板块排序以9月25日完整快照为准。

盘前结论

事实：国内政策继续托底，创新药/软件指数与公司级医药、光模块事件提供结构线索；周五美股先进制造和3D打印/OLED居前。

判断：指数层面仍以防守为主，结构上优先观察有明确里程碑的医药与光模块，电气设备/先进制造和油气反转都需A/H开盘相对强度与成交确认。

不确定性：AKShare为9月25日盘中快照且宽度偏弱；A/H三只重点股最近可靠报价止于9月24日，周一现时尚未开盘；期指回落、油价反弹和融资摊薄都可能使映射失效。

重点个股推荐

华东医药
SZ.000963
条件关注

事实与状态：HDM1002口服GLP-1体重管理三期达到主要及关键次要终点；最近可靠收盘为9月24日26.06元、-1.66%，公告发布后尚无交易价格反馈。

确认条件：开盘后强于医药指数并放量，且上市申请、疗效安全性披露无新增重大不利。

风险与失效：监管审批、商业化竞争、适应症兑现不及预期；若公告后放量弱于医药板块则取消观察。

汇绿生态
SZ.001267
条件关注

事实与状态：拟3.09亿元建设钧恒科技研发生产基地并新增年产200万支高速率光模块产线；9月24日收36.75元、跌2.80%，当前尚无公告后的可靠价格反馈。

确认条件：开盘后强于通信设备/CPO同业、成交放大，项目投资与产能消化安排未出现不利变化。

风险与失效：扩产执行、需求与客户集中风险；若低开后持续弱于板块，维持观察而非转为看多。

金银河
SZ.300619
回避

事实与状态：拟定增不超15亿元，发行上限6785.99万股、约占发行前股本30%；9月24日收26.69元、跌1.98%，尚无公告后的价格反馈。

重新评估条件：发行折价和摊薄可控、项目订单与回报假设得到后续公告验证，且价格重新强于专用设备板块。

风险与失效：较大摊薄、36个月建设周期、需求兑现和资本开支回收风险；当前不把固态电池叙事包装成多头。

板块轮动看板

创新药

央行托底、创新药指数将发布、华东医药三期里程碑形成共振，但最近本地宽度弱，需医药指数与成交确认。

先进制造

美股电气设备、建筑产品、3D打印和OLED居前；A/H只做电气设备、自动化与显示链的窄映射。

光模块与算力

汇绿扩产提供公司级催化，毫米级精度瓶颈和本地弱价格反馈要求条件跟踪，不扩展为全AI多头。

能源与融资

油气周五落后、周一油价反弹构成潜在反转；金银河定增则是产业投入与摊薄并存。

逻辑链

央行适度宽松 + 金融营销新规临近 → 流动性托底与合规约束并存 → 指数不悲观但不追高。
A股4305跌 + 恒生科技-2.14% → 本地广度明显偏弱 → 所有海外映射都必须等待开盘确认。
美股电气设备/建筑产品/3D打印/OLED居前 → 先进制造具有外部线索 → 仅映射到有公告或相对强度的A/H细分。
华东医药三期里程碑 + 汇绿光模块扩产 → 业务催化可核验；金银河较大定增 → 前两者条件关注，后者先回避摊薄。

风险雷达

本地宽度

A股下跌家数约为上涨家数3.8倍，恒生科技跌2.14%，结构线索可能被指数压力覆盖。

油价与地缘

霍尔木兹谈判提供缓和可能，但也门与沙特油设施安全风险仍可推动油价再次上冲。

融资与执行

金银河定增、汇绿扩产均涉及资本开支；摊薄、建设周期、订单与产能消化必须持续验证。

数据时点

AKShare抓取于9月25日12:59 CST、属于9月25日盘中快照；A/H个股最近可靠收盘为9月24日。美股排行覆盖9月25日完整交易，周一同步代表股盘前价不可得。

数据来源与时间点

财联社（9月26日早报：美股、油价、伊美沟通、机器人与长安汽车）、证券时报（9月28日早新闻及9月27日晚公司公告摘要）、中央网信办等八部门《金融产品网络营销管理办法》、上海证券交易所两条新指数公告、东方财富/中新经纬当周日程、MarketWatch（9月25日收盘及9月28日08:32 CST延迟期指/能源报价）。已检查财联社、证券时报与东方财富，金十未取得可核验的对应早报正文。AKShare fetchedAt=2026-09-25 12:59 CST、status=ok、analysisReady=true；美股排行 fetchedAt=2026-09-26 08:51 CST，覆盖9月25日交易并展示行业Top5+Bottom5及概念Top5。15只代表股于08:39 CST批量查询取得周五延长时段报价，但未取得周一同步盘前价；华东医药、汇绿生态、金银河最近可靠收盘为9月24日，卡片均未声称当前价格确认。

Key assets

Keyword map

Weak local breadth Futures giveback Oil reversal watch Policy support STAR index expansion Advanced manufacturing GLP-1 milestone Optical expansion Placement dilution
PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 denotes relevance, not return.
Major news
US market
All three indexes rose Friday as Apple hit another record close
The Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq gained 0.93%, 0.51% and 0.48% on Sep 25, but early Monday futures were down about 0.3%, so cash-session strength did not extend into broad risk-on trading.
Energy
Oil reversed from Friday losses to a Monday rebound
WTI and Brent settled 2.33% and 2.14% lower Friday; delayed quotes around 08:32 showed rebounds to about $93.57 and $98.63, up about 1.26% and 1.22%. Energy is a reversal watch, not a confirmed long.
Geopolitics
Hormuz negotiations coexist with Yemen-related supply risk
Iran and the US continued talks on a seven-day plan for the Strait of Hormuz, while France said it would help protect Saudi oil facilities at Yanbu. Relief and supply risk remain simultaneous.
Policy
PBOC Q3 meeting calls for stronger counter-cyclical adjustment
The meeting retained an appropriately accommodative stance, called for timely tool adjustments and ample liquidity. It supports the index, but the Sep 25 AKShare snapshot still showed 1,120 advancers and 4,305 decliners.
Policy
Online financial-product marketing rules take effect Sep 30
The eight-agency rules clarify the duties of financial firms and third-party platforms and ban false or misleading promotion, forcing compliance upgrades across platforms, brokers, banks and fintech providers.
Policy
Innovative-drug and STAR software-service indexes launch Sep 29
SSE and CSI will launch the SSE STAR Innovative Drug Leaders Index and SSE STAR Software & Services Index, adding tracking tools without guaranteeing immediate gains in constituents.
Industry
Robotics still faces millimeter-level precision constraints
Unitree's Wang Xingxing identified millimeter-scale model-to-physical-world error as a key bottleneck; Changan targets humanoid-robot production in 2028, a clear roadmap with distant commercialization.
US mapping
Electrical equipment, building products and 3D printing led
Electrical Equipment & Parts rose 3.48%, Building Products & Equipment 3.02%, 3D Printing 3.38% and OLED Technology 2.30%. A/H advanced manufacturing remains conditional on local volume and relative strength.
Company
Huadong Pharma reports positive Phase III topline data for oral GLP-1
The HDM1002 China weight-management study met all primary and key secondary endpoints, and Pre-NDA communication is complete. Approval, competition and opening-price feedback remain counter-evidence.
Technology
Huilv plans a CNY309m high-speed optical-module expansion
The project targets capacity for 2m high-speed optical modules a year. The latest available Sep 24 session still fell 2.80%, so the expansion narrative lacks price confirmation.
Company
Golden Milky Way plans a placement of up to CNY1.5bn
Proceeds target sodium-ion and solid-state battery equipment plus silicon materials; the share cap equals 30% of pre-deal shares, so industrial upgrading and dilution must be assessed together.

US overnight summary

Indexes and macro
Friday risk assets rose; Monday futures and precious metals eased
The S&P 500 gained 0.51% Friday; delayed 08:32 data showed S&P, Nasdaq 100 and Dow futures down about 0.29%, 0.32% and 0.33%, with gold down 0.63%.
Sectors and mapping
Advanced manufacturing led while oil shifted from laggard to reversal watch
Electrical Equipment, Real Estate Development and Building Products formed the industry Top 3. Oil E&P and Drilling were in the Bottom 5 Friday, but Monday crude rebounded more than 1%, so A/H energy remains only a potential reversal.
Leader checks
All 15 leaders were batch-checked, without synchronized Monday premarket quotes
Friday extended-hours prints kept ELPW, SRFM, EEIQ and SLMT firm, but they are not synchronized with Monday futures. The ranking uses the complete Sep 25 session snapshot and does not claim current confirmation.

Premarket conclusion

Fact: Domestic policy remains supportive, while new drug/software indexes and company-level pharma and optical-module events provide structural leads; US advanced manufacturing and 3D printing/OLED led Friday.

View: Stay defensive at the index level. Prioritize verifiable pharma and optical-module milestones; electrical equipment, advanced manufacturing and the oil reversal all require A/H opening relative strength and volume.

Uncertainty: AKShare is a Sep 25 intraday snapshot with weak breadth. Reliable quotes for the three A/H focus names end on Sep 24 and Monday has not opened; softer futures, rebounding oil and dilution can invalidate the mappings.

Key stock ideas

Huadong Medicine
SZ.000963
Conditional watch

Fact and status: HDM1002 oral GLP-1 met the primary and key secondary endpoints in the China weight-management Phase III study. The latest reliable close was CNY26.06 on Sep 24, down 1.66%, with no post-announcement price feedback.

Confirmation: Outperform the healthcare index with stronger volume, with no material adverse disclosure on filing, efficacy or safety.

Risk and invalidation: Regulatory approval, commercial competition and weaker-than-expected indication delivery; high-volume underperformance cancels the watch.

Huilv Ecology
SZ.001267
Conditional watch

Fact and status: The company plans a CNY309m R&D and production base with annual capacity for 2m high-speed optical modules. It closed Sep 24 at CNY36.75, down 2.80%, with no reliable post-announcement quote.

Confirmation: Outperform communications/CPO peers after the open with higher volume and no adverse change in investment or capacity-utilization plans.

Risk and invalidation: Execution, demand and customer concentration; sustained underperformance after a weak open keeps it a watch, not a long.

Golden Milky Way
SZ.300619
Avoid

Fact and status: The planned placement is capped at CNY1.5bn and 67.8599m shares, about 30% of pre-deal shares. It closed Sep 24 at CNY26.69, down 1.98%, with no post-announcement price feedback.

Reassessment: Manageable discount and dilution, verified orders and return assumptions, and renewed outperformance versus special-equipment peers.

Risk and invalidation: Material dilution, 36-month build cycles, demand execution and capital recovery; the solid-state-battery narrative is not treated as a bullish call.

Sector rotation board

Innovative drugs

Policy support, the upcoming drug index and Huadong's Phase III milestone align, but weak local breadth requires healthcare-index and volume confirmation.

Advanced manufacturing

US electrical equipment, building products, 3D printing and OLED led; map narrowly to electrical equipment, automation and displays in A/H.

Optical modules and compute

Huilv's expansion is a company catalyst, while precision bottlenecks and weak latest price feedback keep it conditional rather than a broad AI long.

Energy and financing

Oil lagged Friday but crude rebounded Monday, a potential reversal. Golden Milky Way's placement combines industrial investment with dilution.

Logic chain

Accommodative PBOC stance + imminent online-marketing rules → liquidity support plus compliance constraints → avoid both panic and index chasing.
4,305 A-share decliners + Hang Seng Tech -2.14% → clearly weak local breadth → every overseas mapping needs opening confirmation.
US electrical equipment/building products/3D printing/OLED lead → external advanced-manufacturing signal → map only to A/H segments with announcements or relative strength.
Huadong Phase III milestone + Huilv optical expansion → verifiable business catalysts; large Golden Milky Way placement → first two are conditional watches and the third is an avoid.

Risk radar

Local breadth

A-share decliners outnumbered advancers about 3.8 to 1 and Hang Seng Tech fell 2.14%, so index pressure can overwhelm structural leads.

Oil and geopolitics

Hormuz talks offer possible relief, but Yemen and Saudi oil-facility security can push crude higher again.

Financing and execution

Golden Milky Way's placement and Huilv's expansion require capital; dilution, build cycles, orders and utilization all need continued verification.

Data timing

AKShare was fetched Sep 25 12:59 CST and is an intraday snapshot; the A/H focus names' latest reliable closes are Sep 24. US rankings cover the full Sep 25 session, but synchronized Monday leader premarket prices are unavailable.

Sources and timestamps

CLS (Sep 26 morning brief: US stocks, oil, Iran-US talks, robotics and Changan), Securities Times (Sep 28 morning news and Sep 27 evening company disclosures), the CAC/eight-agency Online Financial Product Marketing Measures, SSE's two-index announcement, Eastmoney/China News Service weekly calendar, and MarketWatch (Sep 25 close plus delayed futures and energy around Sep 28 08:32 CST). CLS, Securities Times and Eastmoney were checked; a verifiable matching Jin10 morning-brief body was unavailable. AKShare fetchedAt=2026-09-25 12:59 CST, status=ok, analysisReady=true. US rankings fetchedAt=2026-09-26 08:51 CST, covering Sep 25 with Industry Top 5 + Bottom 5 and Concept Top 5. Batch checks of all 15 leaders at 08:39 CST returned Friday extended-hours prints but no synchronized Monday premarket quotes. Reliable closes for Huadong, Huilv and Golden Milky Way are from Sep 24, and no card claims current price confirmation.

Uncertainty: Iran headlines can reverse oil quickly, KOD has a huge gap and AMPX's verified quote is earlier; every card needs opening volume, yield and relative-strength checks.

If oil and yields fall while leaders hold gains on volume, use selective longs; if both rise further, stay defensive.
